scientific_limitations: Exact distributions are for the Ji–Ma auxiliary map only, with normalized Lebesgue initial data on the first four levels. Do not transfer them to the original Fibonacci bimodal map or induced map. General random-walk formulas and partial critical-only claims are prior work; an unindexed stronger treatment remains possible. Finite computations do not prove infinite identities.
title: Exact space-time excursion laws and two critical windows for the Fibonacci bimodal comparison map
